messages:
maria: Morning — planning to publish py & ts SDK packages in the 2-hour change window at 14:00 UTC. Rolling out canary -> stable. Anyone object?

jonathan: +1. What's the pin strategy for dependent services? we're still running 0.9.x pinned in infra.

maria: Plan: publish canary at 14:00, run smoke consumer tests, then promote to stable at 14:30. We'll also push pinned minor tags: python -> 1.3.x (publish 1.3.0) and keep 1.2.5 as LTS. TS same: 1.3.0.

samir: Need to add deprecation note for legacy sync client in release notes. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/567 — we should call out migration path to async client.

deploy-bot: [14:02:14 UTC] build:ts-sdk-canary succeeded (tag: ts-sdk@1.3.0-canary.1) — artifacts uploaded :tada:

alex: I'll take on the pypi publish step. Remind me credentials — we use CI secret pypi_API_TOKEN in release pipeline?

maria: Yes. CI uses release/pypi token; devex-sre will audit after. Alex, please run `./scripts/release.sh python --canary` then `./scripts/release.sh typescript --promote` once smoke passes.

katie: Smoke test checklist: basic generate, chat streaming, function calling, embeddings dims. I have test harness queued against canary. I'll post failures as threads.

devex-oncall: If we need rollback: for npm use `npm dist-tag` to point stable back. For pypi we prefer to yank 1.3.0 and re-promote 1.2.5 as latest. Also notify customers via #announcements if we hit production regressions.

samir: Rollback commands (copy for runbook):
```
# rollback TS to previous stable
npm dist-tag add @redwood/ts-sdk@1.2.5 stable
# rollback Py: yanking is preferred, then re-promote a previous wheel as latest via CI artifact re-upload
# example (if re-uploading):
# twine upload --repository-url https://upload.pypi.org/legacy/ dist/redwood_inference-1.2.5-py3-none-any.whl
```

alex: noted. Also, internal services should pin to >=1.2.5,<1.4.0 as a recommendation in the release notes — that avoids accidental auto-upgrades to majors.

maria: Timeline recap: 14:00 canary publish, 14:05 smoke tests start, 14:30 promote to stable if green, 14:45 start tagging release notes and deprecation blurb, 15:00 publish release blog + deprecation notice.

jonathan: Do we want to add a short TTL for the canary tag before auto-promote? maybe 25m to give more test coverage.

maria: Let's keep 30m for now (14:00 -> 14:30). If smoke fails, rollback plan is go.

deploy-bot: [14:31:02 UTC] promote:ts-sdk -> ts-sdk@1.3.0 promoted to stable :shipit:

katie: smoke all green for canary (generate/chat/embeddings) — no regressions seen in core paths.

samir: I updated the release notes draft with deprecation section and migration snippet. Pushed to the release PR.

alex: pypi stable published (1.3.0) and changelog uploaded. CI emitted release artifacts.

maria: Great work everyone. After 1 hour let's audit telemetry for cost/latency regressions and open follow-ups if any.

devex-oncall: filed follow-up ticket DEVEX-814: Post-release metrics check and LTS pinning cleanup.
